title: Alien Emerging from Wall
description: A vibrant green alien with a large elongated head, one oversized black eye with a red pupil, and blue lips is breaking through a cracked white wall. It has a long neck, dripping red liquid from its mouth, and a bright pink tentacled appendage with fingers resting on a broken rocky ledge.
